value.message: Town of Oakville runs Preschool A Learn to Swim Saturdays 9:00-9:30am, Sept 12 to Nov 28, for ages 3-5 without a parent in the water - their site says, with fees set in the current Recreation Guide. Fall registration opens Tue, Aug 11 at 7am for Oakville residents; you can browse options online starting Aug 4.
